**About This Role**
**Associate Engineer – BlackRock SMA Solutions**
**About BlackRock SMA Solutions**
 At BlackRock SMA Solutions, our strategies are designed to put our clients’ and their clients’ interests at the center of our investment advice; to minimize costs and taxes; and to incorporate each client’s unique values\-aligned preferences into their investment portfolio. We are a purposefully growing quantitative, multi\-asset investment management business specializing in managing customized portfolios tax efficiently.
   

  

 Technology is central to the success of the SMA business: on a daily basis our technology platform loads portfolio data; we raise and execute orders on our clients’ behalf; we gather security, index, and other essential reference data; we produce rich analytics to highlight risks; and we enable a strong investment research capability.
   

  

 We are looking for talented and passionate engineers who like to innovate and seek complex problems. We recognize that strength comes from teams with a variety of perspectives, and will embrace your unique skills, curiosity, drive, and passion while giving you the opportunity to grow technically and as an individual. We are committed to open source and we regularly give our work back to the community. Engineers looking to work in the areas of orchestration, data modeling, data pipelines, APIs, storage, distribution, distributed computation, consumption and infrastructure are ideal candidates.
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are expanding our team of engineers that owns and operates this extensive technology platform. As a member of this team, you will build, enhance, and support a wide variety of micro\-services that enable financial portfolio construction, data integrations to connect diverse systems, and real\-time operational workflows. You will work with your team and your stakeholders to ensure that platform capabilities address business needs in a complete and timely manner, with validated quality.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, STEM or similar technical field, OR equivalent practical experience
* 2\-5 years of professional software development experience
* Strong Python or C\# experience
* Experience building and supporting production applications, services or APIs
* Strong SQL / relational database experience (MySQL preferred)
* Hands\-on cloud experience (AWS, Azure or GCP, AWS strongly preferred)
* Docker/Containers experience (experience building, packaging and deploying containerized applications)
* Experience with standard software development practices (Git/Source Control, CI/CD, Testing, Debugging/troubleshooting)


**Preferred Requirements**
* AWS Development (Lambda, ECS/EKS, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, RDS, CloudFormation or Terraform
* Experience building cloud\-native or serverless applications
* Experience developing APIs and backend services
* Experience with Pandas and NumPy
* Experience with data\-heavy applications or data processing pipelines
* Experience with Kubernetes
* Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform or CloudFormation
* Experience with distributed or event\-driven systems
* Experience with application monitoring / observability
* Financial/fintech experience, particularly experience with Options, Derivatives, Equities, Bonds, Fixed Income, Capital Markets, Portfolio Management or Trading Workflows

Who is Quantium?
Quantium is a world leader in data science and artificial intelligence. Established in Australia in 2002, Quantium is a global team of more than 1,200 people across 14 locations with a unique blend of capabilities across product and consulting services to help businesses unlock value from data and analytics. Quantium partners with the world's largest corporations to forge a better, more intelligent world.
Product Analytics has embraced AI-native ways of working across our analytical workflows, and we're now moving from adoption to transformation — systematically advancing our analytical assets through an agentic maturity framework we designed ourselves.
The Role
As a Data Scientist you are curious, analytically capable, and excited about learning AI-native ways of working. You'll build upon your foundations in data science, Python, and SQL while learning to combine them with AI tools that are central to how our team operates.
How will you make an impact?
Apply Data Science methodology: including feature engineering, model development, and testing with attention to quality
Build AI-native analytical solutions: Move from simple AI assistance through to agentic workflows, contributing to our agentic maturity framework with guidance from senior team members.
Apply and critically evaluate AI outputs: Use AI tools daily to enhance your workflows and develop the skill of knowing when to trust, refine, or override what AI generates.
Contribute technically across the data lifecycle: Work across data extraction, cleaning, feature engineering, and model development using cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure, and AWS.
Design scalable, reusable approaches: Create specifications engineering teams can implement and build analytical solutions that can be applied across different business challenges.
Collaborate and share knowledge across teams: Work alongside analysts, engineers, and product specialists across geographies — sharing what you learn and contributing to AI-native practices.
Support delivery and continuous improvement: Contribute to project delivery, help resolve analytical questions, and suggest improvements to our processes, timelines, and methods.
The superpowers you’ll be bringing to the team:
1-5 years of experience in data science, AI/ML development, or technical consulting
Strong Python and SQL programming skills for data analysis and manipulation
Solid understanding of data science fundamentals: data preparation, modelling approaches, and validation methods
Familiarity with version control and documentation practices
Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Strong communicator — able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar) in your work or studies — or genuine enthusiasm and a clear willingness to learn
Understanding of ML/AI fundamentals including how LLMs work, transformer architectures, and when to apply different approaches
Remember – you might not tick all the boxes, but don’t let that from stopping you applying. We’re more interested in how you work, your ability to solve problems and think big.
What could your Quantium Experience look like?
Working at Quantium will allow you to challenge your imagination. You will get to solve complex problems using rigor, precision and by asking great questions – but it also means you can think big, outside the box and push your problem-solving skills to the max.
By joining the Quantium team, you’ll get to:
Forge your path: So many of our team have moved around different teams or offices. You’ll be in the driver’s seat, and we empower you to make your career your own.
Find your kind: Embrace diversity and connect with your tribe (think foodies, dog lovers, readers, or runners).
Make an impact: Leave your mark. Your contributions resonate, regardless of your role or rank.
But wait, there’s more!
We’ve got some pretty sweet perks:
Flexible work arrangements : Achieve work life balance at your own pace with hybrid and flexible work arrangements.
Continuous learning : Our vision is empowering analytics talent to thrive. The Analytics Community fosters the development of individuals, thought leadership and technical excellence at Quantium through building strong connections, fostering collaboration, and co-creation of best practice.
Remote working : Embrace the opportunity to work outside of your assigned home location for up to 30 days every year.
Apply now and let's forge a better, more intelligent world together!
